eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['openapi-spec-viewer']; app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('local-api-reference').forEach(l => l.detach()); await p.openFile('Local API Reference/pets.json'); const v = [...p.views].find(v => v.path === 'Local API Reference/pets.json'); p.pro.signOut();  return 'ok'; })()

caption: Open a shallow Pet schema.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['openapi-spec-viewer']; app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('local-api-reference').forEach(l => l.detach()); await p.openFile('Local API Reference/pets.json'); const v = [...p.views].find(v => v.path === 'Local API Reference/pets.json'); p.pro.signOut(); v.selected = 'POST /pets'; v.render(); v.contentEl.querySelector('.lar-schema-links button').click(); v.contentEl.scrollTop = 300; return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro writes an endpoint description to a new note.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['openapi-spec-viewer']; app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('local-api-reference').forEach(l => l.detach()); await p.openFile('Local API Reference/pets.json'); const v = [...p.views].find(v => v.path === 'Local API Reference/pets.json'); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('openapi-spec-viewer-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const f = await p.exportEndpoint(v.spec.endpoints.find(e => e.id === 'POST /pets'), v.path); if (!f) throw new Error('Missing endpoint note'); await app.workspace.getLeaf('tab').openFile(f); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro saves endpoint bookmarks and named tag filters.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['openapi-spec-viewer']; app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('local-api-reference').forEach(l => l.detach()); await p.openFile('Local API Reference/pets.json'); const v = [...p.views].find(v => v.path === 'Local API Reference/pets.json'); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('openapi-spec-viewer-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings.bookmarks = []; await p.bookmark(v.path, 'GET /pets/{id}'); await p.saveFilter('Pet review', 'Pets'); v.selected = 'GET /pets/{id}'; v.tag='Pets'; v.render(); return 'ok'; })()
